title: Colo(u)rful keys!
description: Multi-coloured keys with custom model data.
body:
# Info
This resource pack lets you get custom coloured keys using custom model data, perfect for any adventure maps or minigames!

# Commands:
/give @s minecraft:trial_key[minecraft:custom_model_data={strings:["_insert colour here_"]}]

/give @s minecraft:ominous_trial_key[minecraft:custom_model_data={strings:["white"]}]

# Anvil Naming:
{Colour} Key (Colours need to start with a capital letter)

# Supported colours:
## trial key:
red

yellow

green

cyan

blue

purple

silver


## ominous trial key:
white
